name: display-control
title: Display Control
description: Adjust monitor speaker volume, brightness, and contrast. External displays require m1ddc on Apple Silicon.
author: ViGeng

commands.name: control-displays
commands.title: Control Displays
commands.description: Select a display and adjust its speaker volume, brightness, and contrast with keyboard shortcuts.

preferences.name: m1ddcPath
preferences.title: m1ddc Path
preferences.description: The extension detects Homebrew installations automatically. You can provide an absolute path for a custom installation.

preferences.name: step
preferences.title: Adjustment Step
preferences.description: Slow presses use this percentage of the control's maximum. Rapid repeats accelerate up to 10% per adjustment.

preferences.name: defaultVolume
preferences.title: Default Volume (%)
preferences.description: Reset Volume uses this whole percentage from 0 to 100. The command does not apply it automatically.

preferences.name: defaultBrightness
preferences.title: Default Brightness (%)
preferences.description: Reset Brightness uses this whole percentage from 0 to 100. The command does not apply it automatically.

preferences.name: defaultContrast
preferences.title: Default Contrast (%)
preferences.description: Reset Contrast uses this whole percentage from 0 to 100. The command does not apply it automatically.
